recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-35899 unless Pharmacy later reopens the broader effective[x] modeling question.
issue_request: FHIR-35899 was a Published Pharmacy change request for R5, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking whether MedicationUsage needed a new dateOfLastAdministration element to store the last time a medication was given. The accepted resolution was to use effectiveDateTime for the last time the medication was taken or administered and clarify the comments rather than add an element.
initial_application: Historical commit 0e463239a18c2754e691aecf97c70119c5891b41 was tagged with FHIR-37372, FHIR-35899, and FHIR-36001, but its visible MedicationUsage changes added partOf and schema metadata rather than the effective[x] comment clarification requested by FHIR-35899.
additional_context: MedicationUsage has since been normalized back to MedicationStatement in the active core build. source/fhir.ini lists medicationstatement=MedicationStatement and MedicationStatement=mst. The tightly related FHIR-37372 reconciliation commit 16ecd8d1fd9996fe38850f94da6a80c40f1f5ff0 is already on the combined branch and updated the same MedicationStatement.effective[x] comments, including the exact-date/time and two-resource guidance. Pharmacy WGM minutes on Confluence page 90342275 agree with the Jira disposition, and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-35899. The source-changing work needed for this seed is already present in source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml and the matching Event mapping exception copy, so adding a new element or more prose would be redundant and contrary to the published resolution.

related_jiras.note: Asked how to record both a usage period and last administration time; its already-published reconciliation commit updated the same MedicationStatement.effective[x] comments that satisfy FHIR-35899.
